description: svelte-check needs TypeScript 6 beside TypeScript 7 until it supports 7 directly (docs/plan.md §6.4)
pnpm refuses npm releases younger than a day, so Renovate waits as long (docs/plan.md §6.4)
The Copilot CLI follows the version that the Copilot SDK names, not its newest release (docs/plan.md decision 74)
Each Copilot SDK release names its Copilot CLI version, which mise.toml and the planner's Dockerfile pin (docs/plan.md decisions 74 and 416)
prBodyNotes: Set `copilot` in `mise.toml` and `COPILOT_VERSION` in `services/planner/Dockerfile` to the `copilotCliVersion` in the SDK's `nodejs/package.json` at this release, and `COPILOT_SHA256` to the checksum of `copilot-linux-x64.tar.gz` in that CLI release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `mise run copilot:check` fails until they match.
